title: Count-Min Sketch & Heavy Hitters
interviewAnswer: Count-Min Sketch approximates frequencies in streams with multiple hash tables; queries take the minimum counter and overestimate nonnegative frequencies within probabilistic error bounds.
why: Sketches estimate large-stream frequencies without storing every key.
intuition: Several compressed counters see each event; the minimum reduces collision inflation.
deepDive: Width controls additive error and depth controls failure probability.
commonMistakes: Using the basic sketch for arbitrary negative updates.
followUps: How do you recover heavy-hitter keys?
production: Use when approximate counts are acceptable and throughput/memory dominate exactness.
workedExample: Telemetry can estimate popular URLs across billions of requests in bounded memory.
